verdict.rationale: Foreloop's only documented approval gate is on the task contract before any work starts ('Nothing runs until a person approves a contract. Approval is the only gate'). After that, the agent does the work and opens the pull request itself, with no step to review or approve a diff first. Its review features (automatic product reviews and advisory checks) run only after the PR exists. Missing for 10: any pre-PR diff review step, any approve-or-reject gate on agent changes before PR creation.
